domain_graph: Only relationships from the checked compiled project graph, retaining kind, endpoints, feature/project scope and exact source evidence. No composition reference or value binding creates a domain relationship.
composition_graph: Source-scoped references from already checked project-composition ontology. Composition identity qualifies every node and reference; calls, maps-from, maps-to and depends-on remain local roles, not DS-D8 verbs.
value_bindings: Preserve checked typed core contracts and declarative-function contracts, including ordered expressions, parameters, explicit call arguments, mapping fields, defaults, nullability and result declarations. This projection introduces no additional argument, type inference, evaluation, lookup or execution.
bridges: Only existing explicit core_bindings may connect a composition-local name to a domain selector. Keep property-name mappings and originating source; never infer bridges from labels or matching ontology text.
coverage: Every domain node, domain relationship, composition node, composition reference, typed core contract, declarative function contract and explicit core binding is represented. Untyped domain nodes remain explicitly listed as not having a typed value contract.
validation_ceiling: The graph is a current in-process checked snapshot. Projection is deterministic and provenance-bound, not an additional proof of type compatibility, canonical admission, dataflow execution, runtime count or generated-code conformance.
compatibility: Original graph, source schemas, relationship authority, composition compiler, Rule/factory selections and defaults remain unchanged. Existing Calculation calculates-edge requirements remain visible and are not repaired by a fabricated Operation.
